import sqlite3
db = sqlite3.connect\('data/policy.db'\)
db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
w_count = db.execute\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM winners2022'\).fetchone\(\)[0]
p_count = db.execute\('SELECT COUNT\(*\) FROM winner_pledges2022'\).fetchone\(\)[0]
print\(f'당선인: {w_count}명, 공약: {p_count}개'\)
print\(\)
print\('--- 당선인 샘플 \(5명\) ---'\)
rows = db.execute\('SELECT name, position, region, sg_typecode FROM winners2022 LIMIT 5'\).fetchall\(\)
for r in rows:
    print\(f'  {r[0]} / {r[1]} / {r[2]} \(코드={r[3]}\)'\)
print\(\)
print\('--- 공약 샘플 \(3개\) ---'\)
rows = db.execute\('''
    SELECT w.name, w.position, wp.title, wp.content
    FROM winners2022 w JOIN winner_pledges2022 wp ON w.huboid=wp.huboid
    LIMIT 3
'''\).fetchall\(\)
for r in rows:
    print\(f'  [{r[0]} / {r[1]}] 제목: {r[2]}'\)
    print\(f'    내용: {\(r[3] or \\"\\"\)[:80]}...'\)
" 2>&1)
